en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of the Elbe riverfront in Dresden, showing a busy steamboat landing with docks, small boats and people working along the quay. In the background rise prominent historic buildings and church towers of Dresden's old town, with a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, along with a publisher credit and number.
